crossing_id.title: Crossing ID
crossing_id.description: U.S. DOT Grade Crossing Identification Number assigned by the FRA.

railroad_code.title: Railroad Code
railroad_code.description: Reporting mark of the primary operating railroad.

railroad_name.title: Railroad Name
railroad_name.description: Name of the primary operating railroad.

state_name.title: State Name
state_name.description: State name as published in the inventory (uppercase).

county_name.title: County Name
county_name.description: County name as published in the inventory (uppercase).

city_name.title: City Name
city_name.description: City the crossing is in or near, as published (uppercase).

street.title: Street
street.description: Closest street or road name at the crossing, when published.

highway_name.title: Highway Name
highway_name.description: Name of the highway at the crossing, when published.

latitude.title: Latitude
latitude.description: Latitude of the crossing, when provided by the source.

longitude.title: Longitude
longitude.description: Longitude of the crossing, when provided by the source.

lat_long_source.title: Latitude/Longitude Source
lat_long_source.description: How the coordinates were determined, as published (e.g. Estimated).

crossing_type.title: Crossing Type
crossing_type.description: Crossing ownership type: Public or Private.

crossing_position.title: Crossing Position
crossing_position.description: Crossing position as published (e.g. At Grade).

is_closed.title: Is Closed
is_closed.description: True when the FRA inventory marks the crossing as closed.

warning_device_code.title: Warning Device Code
warning_device_code.description: FRA code for the highest level of warning-device protection at the crossing (source field wdcode).

signs_or_signals.title: Signs or Signals
signs_or_signals.description: True when signs or signals are present at the crossing.

train_detection.title: Train Detection
train_detection.description: Train detection type as published (e.g. None).

whistle_ban.title: Whistle Ban
whistle_ban.description: Whistle ban / quiet zone status as published, when present.

trains_per_day_total.title: Total Trains Per Day
trains_per_day_total.description: Computed total: daytime through + nighttime through + switching + transit movements per day.

passenger_trains_per_day.title: Passenger Trains Per Day
passenger_trains_per_day.description: Passenger trains per day at the crossing.

max_speed_mph.title: Max Timetable Speed (mph)
max_speed_mph.description: Maximum timetable speed over the crossing, in mph.

main_tracks.title: Main Tracks
main_tracks.description: Number of main tracks at the crossing.

highway_aadt.title: Highway AADT
highway_aadt.description: Annual average daily traffic on the highway at the crossing, when published.

highway_aadt_year.title: Highway AADT Year
highway_aadt_year.description: Year of the published AADT count, when present.

revision_date.title: Revision Date
revision_date.description: Date the crossing's inventory record was last revised, YYYY-MM-DD.

source_endpoint.title: Source Endpoint
source_endpoint.description: Official FRA dataset page on data.transportation.gov the records were retrieved from.

scraped_at.title: Retrieved At
scraped_at.description: UTC timestamp of when this Actor retrieved the record (ISO 8601).

title: US Railroad Grade Crossing Inventory Dataset
